title: Add AL-focused AppSource validation guidance
summary: Seven new AppSource validation guidance articles added to help AL developers avoid common issues like hardcoded time zones, UI calls in web services, and missing usage categories on entry points.
key_points: Introduces seven paired good/bad AL code examples for AppSource compliance
Covers company-open subscriptions, profile objects, date literals, page actions, web-service UI calls, entry point configuration, and time-zone handling
Updates the AppSource review skill to direct specific AL signals to relevant guidance articles
Focuses narrowly on AL source patterns without duplicating privacy, style, security, or upgrade domain rules
quote: add seven community AppSource knowledge articles with paired good and bad AL samples
